title: mutable default argument accumulates
description: append_item uses a mutable default list, so items leak across calls. Use None as the default and create a fresh list inside.

hidden_tests.test_defaults.py:
from defaults import append_item


def test_no_shared_state():
    assert append_item(1) == [1]
    assert append_item(2) == [2]
    existing = [9]
    assert append_item(3, existing) == [9, 3]
